parole.testo: Inherited from Byzantine Greek λουλάκιν (loulákin), from Arabic لِيلَك (līlak, “lilac”), from Classical Persian لیلک (līlak).

Inherited from Byzantine Greek μελιντζάνα (melintzána) under the influence of Italian melanzana, both from Arabic بَاذِنْجَان (bāḏinjān, “aubergine”), from Classical Persian بَاذِنْگَان (bāzingān), بَاتِنْگَان (bātingān), ultimately from Dravidian.
